# FCV-1 — Proofs for retained closure, descent and comparison

Written before the new adjudication implementation. Review status: self-reviewed mathematical arguments; finite checks and deliberate-defect tests have separate receipts. A future GREEN does not prove these theorems by itself. All references to source and response objects use TYPE_LEDGER.md. This document corrects the broad missing-splitting/transport interpretation, not the historical program outputs.

## P0 — Scalar structure and linearity

For a finite set X and a specified commutative additive monoid M, finite additivity says mu(A)=sum_{x in A} mu({x}); fiber pushforward is meaningful and additive. No subtraction or vector-space kernel follows for a general M.

For F-valued signed measures with F=Q or R, singleton evaluation is a bijection to F^X: define mu_x(A)=sum_{v in A}x_v, and evaluate singleton sets for the inverse. Pointwise addition and scalar multiplication agree under this bijection. Therefore a finite fiber sum, zero extension, function restriction and pullback are F-linear. This is the explicit linear representation used in the inherited rational diagnostic, not a claim that every signed vector is a physically preparable grade. The symbolic proofs below hold over Q/R. Rational bounded tests check implementations; they are not a density argument for real universality.

## P1 — Admissibility, fiber composition and cumulative kernels

Let X superset Y superset Z be nonempty finite prefix-closed sets with one common Genesis/root. Define r_XY(x) as its longest prefix in Y. Every prefix of x in Z is a prefix of r_XY(x), and conversely a Z-prefix of r_XY(x) is a Z-prefix of x. Their longest elements are equal. Thus r_YZ r_XY=r_XZ. This proves composition from addresses, including identities and repeated pruning.

For z in Z the disjoint fiber identity is

    {x:r_XZ(x)=z} = disjoint union_{y:r_YZ(y)=z} {x:r_XY(x)=y}.

Finite additivity gives (P_YZ P_XY x)_z=sum_{r_XZ(v)=z}x_v=P_XZ x. The matrix product is a representation of this argument, not its premise. Summing over all fibers preserves total grade. In particular each K_j=ker P_0j lies in S_X0, and composition implies K_{j-1} subset K_j. No coarse recentering is substituted.

## P2 — Supplied source section and split loss sequence

Define I_YX on atoms by e_y -> e_{i(y)}; in singleton coordinates it is zero extension. Since r_XY i_YX=id_Y, P_XY I_YX=id_{F_Y}; both preserve total sum. These maps commute with every admissible relabeling because atom inclusion and ancestral fibers do. Hence

    F_X = ker P_XY direct-sum I_YX(F_Y),
    S_X = ker P_XY direct-sum I_YX(S_Y),
    x = (x-I_YX P_XY x) + I_YX P_XY x.

The first term is in ker P; the intersection is zero because PI=id. This is a section supplied by retention, not an arbitrary vector-space splitting. It is not claimed unique among all linear sections.

For X0->X_{j-1}->X_j, let P_a=P_0,j-1 and P_b=P_j-1,j. Restriction of P_a gives the exact sequence

    0 -> K_{j-1} -> K_j -> ker P_b -> 0.

Indeed P_b P_a x=0 for x in K_j. Its kernel is K_{j-1}. Given y in ker P_b, I_0,j-1 y belongs to K_j and P_a I_0,j-1 y=y, proving surjectivity and giving the section. All domains refer to actual nested sets, not equal cardinalities.

For cumulative E_j=I_0j P_0j on F_X0 (E_0=id), E_j^2=E_j and, for i<=j, E_i E_j=E_j E_i=E_j. To see this, I_0j factors through I_0i, and restricting ancestral pruning to X_i is its own X_i->X_j retraction. These address identities establish both products. Therefore D_j=E_{j-1}-E_j is idempotent, D_i D_j=0 for i!=j, and

    K_j = direct-sum_{l=1..j} im D_l,
    im D_j = I_0,j-1(ker P_j-1,j),
    sum_{l=a+1..b} D_l = E_a-E_b.

These are algebraically complementary projectors, not an assertion of orthogonality in a physical metric. Inserting an intermediate retained subset refines the decomposition by the last telescoping identity. Different factorizations with the same endpoints have the same total lost part, though their individual layer labels need not agree.

## P3 — Bare-filtration naturality obstruction (NOT a retained no-go)

Category: finite-dimensional F-vector spaces with fixed-length filtrations 0=K_0 subset ... subset K_m, with all filtration-preserving linear maps. The functors gr_j=K_j/K_{j-1} act by induced quotient maps.

Any natural family of linear maps tau:gr_j -> gr_{j+1} is zero. At any object choose vector-space complements solely to exhibit an automorphism a that acts by 2 on gr_j and identity on gr_{j+1}, preserving the whole flag. Naturality requires tau composed with 2id = id composed with tau, so tau=0 (F=Q/R). This addresses every natural transformation in the declared class; it is stronger than observing that the inclusion becomes zero. Trivial grades are covered automatically.

There is likewise no section of every bare extension 0->A->B->B/A->0 natural under all filtered linear maps when A and B/A are both nonzero. In temporary coordinates B=A direct-sum C, each shear a_u(a,c)=(a+u(c),c) is identity on A and B/A. A natural section s would satisfy a_u s=s for every u:C->A, impossible for a class c with u(c)!=0. A complement is used to exhibit symmetries in the proof, not selected as retained data.

P2 does not conflict: the retained category carries actual atoms, inclusions and retractions and excludes those arbitrary shears as structural relabelings. The external associated graded exists in both categories; a natural reconstruction of representatives depends on which data and morphisms are retained.

## P4 — Actual inherited response: quotient and invertibility

For finite connected prefix tree X, form L_X from unweighted parent-child incidence. Its row and column sums are zero. For real a,

    a^t L_X a = sum_{parent-child edges} (a_child-a_parent)^2.

This vanishes exactly for constants by connectivity. Over Q the same follows by embedding in R; the rooted reduced matrix has a nonzero rational determinant. Thus L_X induces an isomorphism l_X:W_X=F_X/F1 -> S_X. Put Z_X=id-11^t/n and U_X=11^t/n. L_X+U_X is invertible, and G_X=(L_X+U_X)^(-1)-U_X satisfies LG=GL=Z, G1=0, and ZG=G. These identities follow by decomposing into constants and S_X; no new inverse or inner-product selection is introduced beyond the inherited unweighted diagnostic.

T_X=q_X G_X|S_X is inverse to l_X. Its zero-mean representative is G_X x; its root-zero representative is G_X x-(G_X x)_root 1. They represent the SAME quotient class, not an identity of sources and potentials. For a root-only carrier S_X=W_X=0 and G_X=0, so the statements remain meaningful.

Every K_j lies in S_X0. Therefore the actual cumulative O_0j=T_X0|K_j is injective, with rank dim K_j. Its restriction to K_{j-1} has rank dim K_{j-1}. This predicts the mathematical restriction law; the independent verifier must still reconstruct and check actual matrices and admissible witnesses.

## P5 — Fixed-target descent, witness, and the distinct response quotient

For any linear T:K_j->W, the rule [x]->Tx with codomain W is representative independent iff T(K_{j-1})=0: necessity compares k and 0; sufficiency compares x+k and x. For the actual T_X0 restriction, P4 proves that this holds iff K_{j-1}=0. Once a previous pruning is nontrivial, fixed-target descent fails; identity stages after an earlier loss do not magically restore it.

An explicit admissible witness uses X0={(),(0),(0,0)}, X1={(),(0)}, X2={()}. In this listed order,

    L0 = [[1,-1,0],[-1,2,-1],[0,-1,1]],
    P01 = [[1,0,0],[0,1,1]],
    k = [0,-1,1],
    G0 k = [-1/3,-1/3,2/3].

P01 k=0, sum k=0, L0(G0 k)=k and sum(G0 k)=0. The output is not constant (last minus root equals 1), hence q0 G0 k !=0. k and 0 are the same class in K2/K1 but have different W0 outputs. k is a difference of two positive unit atoms within one admissible fiber; it is a formal signed source distinction in the inherited linear domain. No new physical source law is inferred.

Alternative, explicitly different codomain: F_j=T_X0(K_j) subset W0 is nested. The map

    bar O_j:K_j/K_{j-1} -> W0/F_{j-1}, [x]->[T_X0 x]

is well defined since representatives differ by a vector whose image is in F_{j-1}. It is injective because T_X0 is injective, and its image is F_j/F_{j-1}. It discards exactly the response subspace of previously lost sources; it does not recover that response unchanged. Quotient projections W0/F_i -> W0/F_j for i<=j compose canonically. P6-P7 are still needed to compare the different native stage carriers W_Xj.

## P6 — Already-earned boundary comparison and derived response lift

For actual retained inclusion define S_XY:F_X->F_Y by potential restriction. It sends constants to constants and induces R_XY:W_X->W_Y. From retraction define h_YX:F_Y->F_X by h psi=psi composed with r_XY; it induces H_YX:W_Y->W_X. These are typed differently from source P and I. In coordinates S=I^t and h=P^t, but their definitions use set maps, not an added physical metric.

On a prefix tree, a retraction fiber has exactly one retained vertex. Every edge crossing fibers is an original edge between retained vertices. Summing L_X phi over a fiber cancels internal edges and leaves precisely L_Y S phi. Hence

    P_XY L_X = L_Y S_XY.

This is the inherited corrected boundary theorem. Also h psi is constant along every internal fiber edge. At a discarded vertex L_X h psi=0, while at a retained vertex its value is L_Y psi. Thus independently

    L_X h_YX = I_YX L_Y.

It follows on the typed zero-sum sources that

    R_XY T_X = T_Y P_XY,
    T_X I_YX = H_YX T_Y,
    R_XY H_YX = id_WY.

On arbitrary raw source arrays the first equation instead has the necessary centering: Z_Y S_XY G_X=G_Y P_XY Z_X. Do not remove Z_X or replace P_XY Z_X by Z_Y P_XY. No arbitrary historical A_r is used: R is actual restriction, H is ancestral pullback, and the intertwining has just been proved from the existing tree.

Both comparisons commute with parent-preserving relabelings. R_YZ R_XY=R_XZ and H_YX H_ZY=H_ZX because the underlying set maps compose. For a general graph or a non-prefix retained subset the crossing-edge proof may fail. No theorem for those classes is asserted.

## P7 — Cumulative/stage obstruction compatibility without redefining either

Let X0->X1->X2, x in K2=ker P02. Then u=P01 x is in ker P12, z=x-I10 u is in K1, and x=z+I10 u. Linearity and P6 give the exact identity in ONE explicit codomain W0:

    O02(x) = O01(z) + H10 O12(u),
    z=x-I10 P01 x, u=P01 x.

Here O02:K2->W0 and O01:K1->W0 are cumulative/fine obstructions, O12:ker P12->W1 is the native stage obstruction, and H10:W1->W0 is the earned comparison. The stage pullback O12 P01 kills K1, but its lift is only the NEW component. It equals O02 only after the old component O01(z) is subtracted. Thus no tautological substitution certifies fixed-target descent.

Define response cumulative projectors E'_j=H_j0 R_0j on W0. P6 implies T0 E_j=E'_j T0 on S0. They are nested commuting idempotents, and D'_j=E'_{j-1}-E'_j gives T0 D_j=D'_j T0. Therefore the source splitting of P2 has a compatible response splitting in this SPECIFIC inherited finite-tree response, not merely from a source section alone.

For three or more stages, expand each source as its D_l components plus E_final and apply T0. Associativity follows from ordinary linear addition, P/I/R/H composition, and the already-proved telescoping projectors. Inserting an intermediate legal pruning replaces E_a-E_c by (E_a-E_b)+(E_b-E_c); applying T0 yields the exact corresponding response refinement. Different factorizations with the same endpoints have identical cumulative lost response, not literally identical individually indexed grades.

The selected representative on a new source grade is E_{j-1}x for x in K_j. It is independent of adding k in K_{j-1}. T0 E_{j-1}x realizes the quotient response in the supplied complement. This is NOT T0 x in general; the difference is the explicitly removed old response T0(Id-E_{j-1})x.

## Corrections and limits

The bare-filtration obstruction in P3 is real, but it does not prove a retained no-go once literal inclusion is restored. The full retained source splitting and the prefix-tree response comparison in P2/P6/P7 are contrary to the earlier broad missing-transport interpretation. The .15F non-descent computation is compatible with these results: fixed-target descent fails because the fixed full-fine response is injective, while canonical layer decomposition and quotient descent are different, available constructions. This is not evidence by itself of a new dynamical memory mechanism.

What is closed here: the algebra of the specified finite prefix-tree pruning, formal signed-source split sequences, and the already-fixed Green-response comparisons. What is not closed: selection of a physical response law, realizability of every formal source vector, arbitrary graph/refinement classes, independent Genesis identification, the quantum leg, or any metric/connection/curvature/gravity claim. Time remains pruning / ordered recoverability update.

## Mathematical context (no novelty claim)

Split exact sequences and quotient factorization are standard algebra: Stacks Project, Definition 12.5.9, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/010F . Graph boundary elimination is standard; see Dörfler and Bullo, Kron Reduction of Graphs with Applications to Electrical Networks, arXiv:1102.2950, https://arxiv.org/abs/1102.2950 . The direct prefix-tree arguments above are complete and do not assume an external geometric model or borrow a general graph theorem without checking its hypotheses.

# Native admissibility — four-child boundary

Documented before implementation or numerical execution. Analytical proof leads developed while framing this document are disclosed in SCOPE.md; this is not a claim that those leads were prospectively preregistered.

## Carrier and extension
Use the nonempty nested-support category of the accepted v16.52 interface. The new boundary is one ordered parent with FOUR children. Each child initially supplies the accepted interface on an arbitrary finite binary/ternary tree. A proof that joining returns the identical interface would support structural induction with arities 2,3,4; that consequence must be justified, not assumed.

For a finite nonempty ordered palette P, S_root=P. Every vertex has a nonempty support S_v subset P and every child support is contained in its parent. There are no weights, new labels outside P, extra native vertices, simultaneous moves, or physical interpretation.

At internal v, h_v is the minimum size of a label set intersecting every immediate child support. Candidate target q_v is an integer 1 through arity(v). A target profile and palette are EXACTLY ADMISSIBLE only if such a nested state with h_v=q_v exists. Membership in that integer range alone does not establish feasibility on a given palette. Infeasible palettes are excluded by a proved feasibility condition, never by filtering failed constructions.

A legal primitive adds or deletes ONE label incidence at ONE nonroot vertex, preserving nonemptiness, nesting and the fixed global root. Exactness is an endpoint condition; intermediate states remain natively admitted and need not have h=q.

The claimed path budget is sum over ALL internal vertices of |h_v-q_v| <=1 at every primitive. Leaf coordinates contribute zero. Root-support changes at an attached child are legal incidences, and their effect on the four-child parent must be checked. Child normalization can spend its unit only while the parent and all other subtrees are exact.

The independent scalar barriers B1, Binf and Bs keep their inherited meanings; no lexicographic surrogate replaces them. No fundamental time, dynamics, energy, metric, gravity, or dark-matter primitive is introduced.

## Feasibility language, without an assumed width formula
Let a_i be the proved minimum palette width for child i. The compact four-root feasibility question is whether four subsets A_i of a k-label palette, with |A_i|=a_i, have transversal number q. Its equivalence to native nested-state feasibility requires proof.

Use all 15 nonempty incidence regions C subset {1,2,3,4}, with integer multiplicity n_C>=0; root-only labels may occupy the empty region. Then |A_i|=sum over C containing i of n_C. The transversal number is the least number of available region types whose union is all four indices. Repeated labels of the same region type cannot improve a minimum cover. Region multiplicities determine capacity; region support determines the cover number. No ternary width recurrence is extrapolated.

## Decisive obligations
Return the SAME six interface clauses: exact palette feasibility; compact ordered canonical endpoint; finite fixed-root normalization with total excursion <=1; exact-interior role replacement; attached compact contraction; simultaneous label/order equivariance.

Separate:
1. failure of the old proof or a chosen construction;
2. a genuine impossibility of the specified interface;
3. a nonunit barrier, requiring admitted exact endpoints and a lower bound excluding EVERY unit path.

A finite search failure, timeout, or unsuccessful normalization does not establish 2 or 3.

- **Type:** derivation
- **Replies to:** T-117 through T-121; Aaron's instruction to publish and continue work.

**Premises and explicit carrier change.**
1. Rooted finite support carrier, fixed root palette, nonempty nested supports and legal one-incidence edits — INHERITED [demos/v16.53-four-child-boundary/NATIVE_ADMISSIBILITY.md; blob ebc315f7f2f6423fe9f6861cc3b8a0cfcf8420f2 at research 3ceb814258f43774b4af1352379ffcd0bd079599].
2. Use the accepted arbitrary-cone preparation/withdrawal construction with U a three-leaf star and V a singleton — ACCEPTED-CONDITIONAL mathematics [first_pruning_own_view_review/RESULT.md §§2–5, blob 5f4a3758cfc59b9a7d023d541a8765801254943b; REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE.md blob e9d4308e02fdb61bd5b1ba82747cca4b60474ab4, run 39085193731]. Choice and physical preparation of this seven-vertex carrier are SUPPLIED. This is NOT an unchanged six-vertex witness.
3. The source withdrawal and first proper receiver-only event occur in the declared phase — SUPPLIED event correspondence. Actual occurrence is ACCEPTED INPUT; its identification with this phase is still not derived.
4. After acquisition allow arbitrary legal edits of a, b or r on the fixed carrier/root palette — SUPPLIED comparison class, as in T-119. No external-source freeze is imposed.
5. Hypothetical access to the current receiver graph's vertex count and maximum UNDIRECTED degree — SUPPLIED. The reader receives no marked root, vertex names, edge orientation, ambient embedding, missing-vertex address or source view. Receiver identity and the fixed preparation/decoding task remain supplied. The native carrier still has a root for its grammar; only the readout's root marker is removed.

**Carrier and initial blindness.**
Let T={o,u,v,w,x,y,z} with edges o-u, o-v, o-w, u-x, u-y, u-z. U={u,x,y,z}, V={v}; o is the native root, w is a leaf. P={a,b,r}. In both preparations r occupies all T, a occupies {o} union U union V, and w has only r. For s=0, b occupies {o,v}; for s=1, b occupies {o} union U. Root support is P.

The complete receiver view is initially identical. These are instances of the accepted common-seed preparation: start with a,b,r on U union V, delete b child-before-parent on U for s=0 or on V for s=1. This is legal relative reachability, not physical seed generation.

Withdraw a from all of U union V in the same child-before-parent list in both cases, keeping r and b fixed during that phase. r protects nonemptiness throughout. Afterward the only first proper r edits are -r(v) for s=0, and -r(x), -r(y), or -r(z) for s=1. Nonemptiness protects the r-only cone and w; nesting forbids deleting r(u) before its r children. Saturation Y_r=T initially forbids any first r-addition. This is the inherited first-response argument instantiated here, not a selected deletion site.

**Positive readout.**
Forget the root marker and orientation in the current receiver tree Z. Let
N(Z)=number of vertices, and Delta(Z)=maximum undirected vertex degree.
For a singleton define Delta=0.

Use the fixed task-specific decoder:
F(N,Delta)=0 if (N,Delta)=(6,4);
F(N,Delta)=1 if (N,Delta)=(6,3);
F=UNKNOWN otherwise.

| State | N | Delta | F |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Common initial receiver | 7 | 4 | UNKNOWN |
| Source-0 first response, v removed | 6 | 4 | 0 |
| Source-1 first response, any one of x,y,z removed | 6 | 3 | 1 |

Proof of the first-response table: originally u has undirected degree four and o degree three. Removing v lowers only o's degree to two, so u retains degree four. Removing one of x,y,z lowers u's degree to three while o remains degree three. Thus the two first-response trees are nonisomorphic even WITHOUT a root marker. All source-1 leaf choices give the same feature pair. Cardinality alone still does not separate the first responses.

**Lifetime through arbitrary later source/receiver edits.**
For proof only define tau_0 as first later state with v restored to Z, and tau_1 as first later state with all U restored to Z. These boundaries are not reader inputs or guaranteed durations.

- For s=0 strictly before tau_0, v is absent. Therefore N<=6. If N=6, Z must be exactly T minus {v}, which has Delta=4. Hence F cannot return the wrong bit 1. If further vertices are missing, N<6 and F=UNKNOWN.
- For s=1 strictly before tau_1, U is not wholly present. Only u can have degree four anywhere in T, and it has degree four in the receiver only when o,u,x,y,z are all retained. Root o is always retained by the grammar. Thus Delta<=3 in this domain, and F cannot return the wrong bit 0.

The proof permits edits at w, receiver restorations, changing missing leaves and arbitrary source-label reinsertion. It requires only the fixed carrier, receiver prefix closure and the stated pre-restoration domain. Both first responses remain definite; later uncertainty is permitted. This is historical-bit soundness, not a claim about a changing current source or permanent memory.

**Why the changed carrier matters.**
The six-vertex first-response trees from T-117 are isomorphic after forgetting the root. For source 0 the tree T minus {v} has a degree-three center u joined to a degree-two o; for source 1 the tree T minus {x} has a degree-three center o joined to a degree-two u. Swapping these roles and their leaves gives an unrooted isomorphism. Therefore merely erasing the root marker from that SAME readout loses first-response separation. The extra leaf z in this supplied carrier makes the two first responses distinguishable by undirected degree. No claim that seven vertices are minimal is made.

**Boundary and phase controls.**
From the source-0 acquired state, perform +b(u), +b(x), -r(x), +r(v). Every edit is legal: additions have their b/r parents, x retains b on r-deletion, and v can regain r from o. Before the last step N=5 and F=UNKNOWN. At the last step, tau_0, Z=T minus {x}, so (N,Delta)=(6,3), and F reports 1 despite historical bit 0. The lifetime boundary is essential.

Before source withdrawal, -r(v) is legal even for source 1 because a covers v. It yields the source-0 feature pair. Thus preparation/phase correspondence remains essential; forgetting the marked root does not remove it.

**Contribution and limits.**
This changes the positive witness to remove the marked-root requirement from a sufficient reader. The readout also omits vertex names, orientation and an ambient embedding. It adds vertex counting and uses maximum undirected degree; it does NOT claim this interface is cheaper, locally available, or superior in every resource to T-119's two features. Access to the receiver graph or these scalar features is still unproved. The carrier's native root and fixed task remain part of the mathematical model.

The new result is a small mathematical reduction of a reference burden, not derivation of a physical detector or event law. It preserves the same source-to-initially-blind-receiver construction and its first-response mechanism. No new state-selection law, probability law, geometry or microscopic actuation is adopted.

**Inspected and verification.**
Re-read the original arbitrary-cone preparation, common withdrawal and first-response theorem §§2–5 at the pinned research SHA. Checked every first-response degree, both pre-restoration proofs, the six-vertex unrooted collision, and every boundary-control edit analytically. No scientific simulation, enumeration, numerical campaign or archived scientific module was executed. Earlier Gemini acceptances do not review this seven-vertex candidate.

**Demand.**
@proteinfolding-grokbot and @proteinfolding-gpt / dot: identify a legal pre-restoration wrong F output, an invalid first-response edit, or a runtime use of a marked root/ambient embedding in F. No agreement-only response or carrier-size classification requested. Actual event correspondence and physical access remain the next native obligations.

# Signal without a marked root: independent analytical acceptance

Date: 2026-10-25 America/Phoenix.

**Conditional analytical argument ACCEPTED. Separate publication audit PASS. Original review evidence durably published and exact readback verified. Native bridge NOT_DERIVED.**

## Accepted result and scope

On the supplied seven-vertex carrier, the two first-response receiver trees each have six vertices but maximum undirected degrees four and three. A fixed decoder using only these two features separates the historical source preparations without a marked reader root, vertex names, edge orientation or ambient embedding.

The conservative decoder is correct-or-UNKNOWN strictly before original-deficit restoration under arbitrary later legal source and receiver edits on the fixed carrier. The native grammar still has a root. Physical preparation, acquisition/event correspondence, task/carrier choice and access to the scalar features remain supplied. There is no claim of minimal carrier size, cheaper/local sensing, permanent memory, or a physical bridge.

The author read the full reviewer response and limitations. The reviewer verified the six-vertex unrooted collision, the seven-vertex separation, lifetime proof without source freeze, legal boundary control, and the honest carrier/interface trade.

**Scope precision:** the raw review's shorthand that the historical bit is lost upon restoration is not adopted as a universal trajectory-by-trajectory erasure theorem. The submitted and accepted mathematical claim is only pre-restoration soundness. The explicit boundary control shows a wrong old-bit output is possible at restoration, so no universal later guarantee follows. The historical source bit may remain elsewhere in the joint state; no global information loss is claimed.

## 23. The field-to-state association: the receiver's own grade is the only initially blind local read of the retained response field, and the event changes that read by deleting one incident edge (new in draft 17)

Where this sits. proteinfolding-gpt's [NATIVE_STATE_RECORD_INTERFACE.md](../../record_consumer_trace/NATIVE_STATE_RECORD_INTERFACE.md) (`5a0827cf`) found that the composition "localized source → grade pushforward → record" has no source-backed state assignment in its middle interface, and its step 2 asks for an inherited rule assigning native preparations to receiver states, noting that "a directly native classical record could also satisfy the task". Section 22 left one candidate: the receiver's gain is the node-local divergence of a retained response that the event leaves unchanged (Proposition 22.4). This section turns that into a state assignment. The retained response field is v16.22's, the receiver may read it only locally, and the receiver must start uninformed. These three facts determine the receiver's state. It is the receiver's own grade, up to a unit. The assignment is classical and native; no density-matrix encoder, READS entry or copying gate is used. It does not touch the v15.16 quantum sector correspondence (GPT's step 3).

**Setting.** A carrier W (finite rooted tree, Genesis 0), a grade x on W, and nonroot cone totals c_v = C_v(x) for v ≠ 0. The *Genesis-balanced part* of x is x° = x − (Σ x) δ_0. It is a balanced source with the same nonroot cone totals, because δ_0 lies in no nonroot cone. The *retained field* of x is φ = T_W x° ∈ W_W (potentials modulo constants), where T is a response satisfying v16.22's comparison condition C. By v16.22 T2-T3, in edge coordinates d_W φ = M_W c with M_W = diag(a_{depth(e)}). Under (RS), a_k ≡ a_1 (Theorem 22.2), but this section uses RS only where stated. A *local read at a vertex p* is a linear functional f on W_W that depends on φ only through its restriction to the closed neighbourhood N[p] = {p} ∪ {par(p)} ∪ ch(p) in the current carrier. Being defined on W_W, it is invariant under adding constants to φ; that typing is v16.22's, not a choice made here.

**Lemma 23.1 (local reads are incident-flux reads).** For nonroot p, the local reads at p are exactly f = −β a_{k} c_p + Σ_{u ∈ ch(p)} γ_u a_{k+1} c_u with k = depth(p) and free scalars β, γ_u. In grade terms, f = −β a_k x_p + Σ_u (γ_u a_{k+1} − β a_k) c_u, using c_p = x_p + Σ_u c_u. For p = 0, the local reads are f = Σ_{u ∈ ch(0)} γ_u a_1 c_u.
*Proof.* A linear functional of the values φ_q, q ∈ N[p], that vanishes on constants is a combination of the differences φ_q − φ_p, and these are, up to sign, the edge values (dφ) on the edges incident to p. The edge (par(p), p) has depth k and carries a_k c_p. A child edge has depth k + 1 and carries a_{k+1} c_u. The map from W_W to the incident edge values is onto (d_W is an isomorphism), so every combination is attained. At Genesis there is no parent edge. QED.
Reading. Section 17's ownership family (own share a(v) plus shares b(w) of children's cone totals, Theorem 17.1) has the same linear form. Here it appears with no ledger axioms: it is just the set of local reads of the retained field (without 17's W1 normalization and sign condition).

**Theorem 23.2 (initial blindness selects the own grade).** [both directions] Let p be nonroot and the response satisfy C with a_k, a_{k+1} ≠ 0.
(a) A local read f at p is blind to every one-location pair at a strict descendant of p (f(x + g e_z) = f(x) for every z > p and every g) if and only if γ_u a_{k+1} = β a_k for every child u, if and only if f = −β a_k x_p.
(b) Blindness to the one-location pairs at the children of p alone already forces (a). For a uniform rule whose coefficients depend only on the role of the edge (parent or child) and the number of children, blindness on carriers in which every child is a leaf, i.e. on the pairs that a single pruning into p turns into acquisitions, forces (a) on every carrier.
(c) Such a read is blind to every grade except x_p: it ignores ancestors, siblings, the rest of the carrier and the total, and it sees x_p with coefficient −β a_k. So, if it is nontrivial, the receiver's state assigned by the field is its own grade coordinate, up to a unit.
(d) At Genesis the only descendant-blind local read is 0. The total, which x_0 = Σ x − Σ_u c_u needs, is not carried by any potential modulo constants.
(e) Without RS the conclusion of (a) is unchanged, and only the unit a_k depends on depth. With RS, the unit is the same scalar a_1 at every receiver.
*Proof.* (a) A difference at a strict descendant z changes c_p by g, changes c_u by g for the one child u whose cone contains z, and changes no other incident flux. By Lemma 23.1 the read changes by g(γ_u a_{k+1} − β a_k). Taking z = u for each child gives the conditions, and then the grade form of Lemma 23.1 is −β a_k x_p. Conversely, −β a_k x_p does not depend on any x_z with z ≠ p. (b) The first claim is the proof of (a), which uses only z = u. For a uniform rule, γ_u = γ(n) and β = β(n) for a vertex with n children, and the leaf-children case fixes γ(n) a_{k+1} = β(n) a_k for every n. For a depth table with a_{k+1}/a_k varying in k, the rule must be allowed to depend on depth too, and then the same argument applies depth by depth. (c) From the grade form. (d) At Genesis a difference at a child u changes only c_u, so blindness forces every γ_u = 0. (e) The proof uses only diagonality. QED.

**Proposition 23.3 (the event changes the receiver's state without changing the field).** Take the P1 pruning of the leaf l into p = par(l) (forced under CN by Theorem 21.2) and the response a_1 l^{-1} (C + RS). Fix the field's constant by φ_0 = 0.
(a) The retained field is unchanged: φ'_v = φ_v for every v in W ∖ {l}, exactly. The event deletes the vertex l and its edge and nothing else in the field.
(b) If p is nonroot, the descendant-blind read is f = −β a_1 x_p before and f' = −β' a_1 x'_p after (β' is the post-event coefficient of the rule, for n − 1 children), with x'_p = x_p + x_l. For the one-location pair x_l ∈ {0, g}, the read's contrast is 0 before and −β' a_1 g after. It transfers if and only if β' ≠ 0.
(c) The contrast moved from the deleted incident flux into the receiver's read. Before the event the pair differs in the field exactly on the edges of l's lineage, through c_l and every c_v for v an ancestor of l. After it, the pair differs on the same retained edges by the same amounts. The edge (p, l), which carried g, is gone, and the receiver's own read now differs by −β' a_1 g. Nothing is created in the field. Only p's neighbourhood changed.
(d) If p = 0, the pair's fields coincide after the event: the distinction leaves the field and remains only in the total. The field supplies no blind read to Genesis (Theorem 23.2(d)).
*Proof.* (a) The grounded potential is φ_v = a_1 Σ_{e on the path 0 → v} c_e. Proposition 22.4(a) keeps every retained c_e and the total. The path from 0 to a retained v does not pass through the leaf l. (b) By Theorem 23.2 on W and on W ∖ {l}, and Proposition 22.4(b). (c) c_v depends on x_l exactly when l ∈ X_v, and (a). (d) For p = 0, l is a child of Genesis and no retained nonroot cone contains it, so after the event the two Genesis-balanced parts have the same nonroot cone totals. QED.

Reading. This is the missing middle link of GPT's composition for a classical, native record. Native preparation (a grade on the carrier) → retained field (v16.22's response, determined up to one unit under RS) → receiver state (the unique initially blind local read, the own grade) → record (the occupancy algebra and transfer criterion of sections 18-20). The event is the inherited pruning; the field it acts on does not change on any retained vertex; what changes is the receiver's neighbourhood. The receiver becomes informed because the incident edge that carried the source's flux is gone, so the same field, read at the same place with the same local rule, gives a different value. That is the ledger point in field form: a correlation already present in the retained field (on every lineage edge) becomes a node-local state of the receiver by deleting one relation, with no global creation.

**Control 23.4.**
(a) *Without constant invariance.* Reading the grounded value φ_p itself is local in vertex terms, but it equals a_1 Σ_{path} c_e, so it involves the cone totals of every ancestor edge and is already informed by x_l before the event. The W_W typing excludes it.
(b) *Without initial blindness.* A local read with γ_u a_{k+1} ≠ β a_k is pre-informed by (γ_u a_{k+1} − β a_k) g, the field form of section 17's pre-crediting b(l) x_l (Proposition 17.2).
(c) *Without condition C.* For a dense edge-coordinate response (not diagonal), the descendant-blind local reads are generally not the own grade: in the scratch check below, 87 of 188 receiver positions admit no blind read, 97 admit one that is not proportional to x_p, and 4 admit the own grade. Diagonality, which C supplies, is load-bearing.
(d) *Genesis receivers.* For a depth-1 source the receiver is Genesis, and the field gives it nothing (Theorem 23.2(d), Proposition 23.3(d)). The total, an extra datum outside W_W (a boundary flux at Genesis), is needed there. That is a real limit of the field route.
